collision_check: Names checked against the live OpenKit3D pack-folder list (218 folders), the live OpenKit 2D pack list, and the stems of earlier Open Kit families. No live pack is named for keep, gatehouse, portcullis, cresset, arrow-slit, loophole, window-bars, floor-channel, or pressure-plate. Nearby live packs (doors-windows, dungeon-clutter, fence-gate, light-hearth, wall-dress) are different families. No family was swapped.
judgment_calls: Facing in the raw FBX (Y-up): the arrow-slit's wide splay is on +Z, and the slim slot and iron lip are on −Z. The portcullis and the barred window have no one-sided front. In Build's baked world-coordinate check on 25 Nov 2026 (Unity 6000.4.0f1, Convert Units on, Bake Axis Conversion on), the wide splay was on Unity +Z, the front; other importers or settings may differ.
Portcullis is a closed, non-animated grate; collision covers the opening with one thin solid panel.
Pressure-plate proud height is 0.8 mm so floor-top pivot, room-adapt and slightly-proud gates all pass; the plate is easy to miss from a typical camera.
Cresset collision is one convex envelope around the whole prop, so nothing can pass between the legs.
Flat 512 px slot albedos with light noise; image nodes are not in the FBX materials.

assets.name: wall-dungeon-portcullis
assets.desc: Wall module with a closed iron portcullis in a stone arch: jambs, sill, lintel, cap course, eight pointed verticals and five rails. It does not open.

assets.name: wall-dungeon-arrow-slit
assets.desc: Wall module with a tall splayed loophole that widens toward the front face and narrows to a slim slot at the back, coursed stone, cap course and a small iron sighting lip at the back.

assets.name: wall-dungeon-window-bars
assets.desc: Solid wall module with a small high window: stone sill and lintel, five round bars and two straps.

assets.name: tile-dungeon-floor-channel
assets.pivot: floor_top: walking surface at z=0, tile extends 0.12 m below
assets.desc: Stone floor tile with a front-to-back open gutter, iron lips, end straps and a dark silt surface. The gutter is shallow.

assets.name: tile-dungeon-floor-pressure-plate
assets.pivot: floor_top: walking surface at z=0, tile extends 0.12 m below; plate 0.0008 m proud
assets.desc: Stone floor tile with a closed centre plate, 0.8 mm proud, a joint gap around it, four corner rivets and a faint centre seam. The plate does not move.

assets.name: prop-cresset-iron
assets.desc: Standing iron fire basket: three splayed legs on a ring base, a post, a banded basket with a grate and four coals.
